_doc: Material library (not loaded by ContentDB). tools/build_assets.py writes assets/generated/materials/<id>.tres for each entry. Models reference materials by name M_<id>. Shaders live in game/assets/shaders/. 'textures' = texture set prefix (<set>_albedo/_normal/_orm); 'layers' bind secondary sets (moss, wear) as <layer>_albedo_tex etc.
